summary_en: Sysmex completed cancellation of 21,138,200 shares (3.36% of issued shares before cancellation) on September 30, 2026, reducing issued shares to 608,341,876.
title_en: Notice Regarding Completion of Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Sysmex Corporation completed the cancellation of 21,138,200 treasury shares on September 30, 2026, pursuant to a resolution adopted at the Board of Directors meeting held on March 5, 2026. The shares cancelled represented 3.36% of the issued shares outstanding before cancellation, under the provisions of Article 178 of the Companies Act.

Following the cancellation, the total number of issued shares (excluding treasury stock) was reduced to 608,341,876 shares.
